prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1049; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Appraiser's remarks: The vehicle shows impact damage to the front left quarter, including a cracked headlamp assembly, a deformed fender, and a bent wheel support on that side. Some of the lower bumper scuffing may be older or from a separate contact, so it is not clear whether every mark came from this impact. The repair plan calls for replacing the headlamp and fender, straightening the support, and refinishing the panels. The labor hours requested match the damage described. The invoices show no repeated charges. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known to this office.
